observations.trace: A crates-source textual search found the build_scene_ground definition, one import and one direct call from prepare_geographic_terrain. That path invokes validate_source first: validate_grid requires both source height and environment arrays to equal checked width×depth. At spacing≤2m upsampling clones both arrays; otherwise its nested width×depth loops push one height and one environment value per cell. Assuming upsampling returns normally, prepare_terrain receives mutable slices and does not resize them. The admitted SceneTerrain is built with those same dimensions and checks its derived grid depth. The ground producer maps one sample per environment item and indexes the terrain grid before the final from_samples check. These steps establish matching cardinality on this selected returned path rather than a demonstrated panic.
